claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the value and price, often noting it is cheaper than local or other online options.
Many customers use it for DIY tinctures, including cannabis and glycerin-based tinctures, and report good results.
It is commonly used for skin, hair, and body care, with reviewers reporting hydrating and conditioning benefits.
Several vapers use it for DIY e-liquid and report good quality, purity, and no odd flavor.
One reviewer reports deceptive labeling regarding the Kosher claim, contradicting another reviewer who states it is Kosher.
